Create corrected asset A04 (pleat-macro) for the Korean Coupang detail-page source library of "루즈핏 쿨토시", manufacturer "살랑".

Final output must be exactly 1024x1024. Compose for this ratio from the start and keep all subjects center-crop-safe.

REAL-PRODUCT IDENTITY LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY:
Image 1 is a real user photograph of the exact product and outranks every other reference.
The exact product is a white pair of long, loose arm sleeves. Supplier-stated flat size is 47 cm long by 14 cm wide.
For every fully visible single sleeve, preserve a length-to-flat-width ratio of about 3.36:1. It must read as long and narrow, with about 80% of the frame height used when vertical.
Preserve the near-parallel long side edges, lightweight slightly lustrous synthetic fabric, extremely fine horizontal micro-lines, and irregular soft longitudinal drape wrinkles visible in the real photos.
Preserve the narrow gathered elastic upper-arm opening, the gathered transition into the long wide hand cuff, the side thumb opening, and the white woven label with exact black two-line text "HELLO" over "CUTE SLEEVE" where the labeled face is shown.
Do not shorten, squash, widen, taper into an hourglass, inflate into a balloon, or turn it into a leg warmer.
Do not invent thick rib knit, rope-like pleats, sports compression panels, mesh panels, zippers, drawstrings, silicone strips, anti-slip dots, extra seams, extra openings, extra labels, or detached hang tags.
No UV percentage, UPF grade, cooling number, temperature graphic, moisture-wicking claim, ventilation claim, anti-slip claim, certification mark, or performance icon.

Show a broad section of the loose sleeve body with part of the upper gathered elastic edge softly receding in the background for product context.
The macro must preserve the real lightweight slightly lustrous surface, extremely fine horizontal micro-lines, and irregular soft lengthwise drape wrinkles.
It must not become thick ribbed knit, rope-like vertical cords, gauze, waffle, fleece, or exaggerated accordion pleats.
Use soft side light to reveal only the physically present texture.

Clean commercial product photography with controlled studio lighting, smooth continuous gradients, crisp but natural edges, clean shadow transitions, physically plausible material texture only, and low-ISO clarity.
No film grain, sensor noise, chromatic noise, dithering, speckle, crunchy micro-texture, halftone, JPEG artifacts, oversharpening, dirty shadow noise, artificial glitter, waxy blur, or plastic skin.
No advertising copy, title, caption, badge, icon, price, watermark, UI, or invented logo.
Keep every important product edge, hand, face, and limb safely inside the center-crop-safe area.
